headline: Nadda calls on Uttarakhand BJP workers to ensure victory in 2027 assembly polls
content: Shimla, Oct 10 (PTI) Union health minister JP Nadda called on the Uttarakhand BJP workers to rally together to ensure the party’s victory in the 2027 assembly elections. Nadda made these remarks during his visit to Kullu on Friday evening, where he held a discussion over tea (chai par charcha) with BJP workers at Sundernagar, the gateway to Mandi district, BJP leaders said on Saturday. This message, delivered during an informal meeting, is considered significant for the Himachal BJP’s future electoral strategy and organisational preparedness. “I was able to meet all of you under the pretext of having tea. I had only been asked to stop for a cup of tea, but I had no idea that such a large number of party workers and elected representatives would be waiting here for so long”, Nadda told the workers. He urged party workers to set their sights on the 2027 goal right away and dedicate themselves to serving the public with full efficiency and dynamism. The Union minister also called upon them to take the central government’s public-welfare schemes and the Narendra Modi government’s commitment to service, good governance, and the welfare of the poor to every household and every polling booth.
